findings.explanation: Lean proves `THE none = ARB` by reflexivity. HOL4 saves only `THE (SOME x) = x`. Any value at `NONE` satisfies that equation.
findings.repair:
private axiom theNone {α : Type u} [Nonempty α] : α

noncomputable def THE {α : Type u} [Nonempty α] : Option α → α
  | some x => x
  | none => theNone
findings.lean_check:
import CmlTS.Prelude.List

example {α : Type} [Nonempty α] : CmlTS.THE (none : Option α) = CmlTS.ARB := rfl
findings.hol4_check: !v:'a. ?f:'a option -> 'a. (f NONE = v) /\ (!x. f (SOME x) = x)

findings.explanation: Lean proves `HD [] = ARB` by reflexivity. HOL4 saves only `HD (h::t) = h`, which leaves the empty-list value open. The same Lean branch also forces `EL 0 [] = ARB` through the defining equation `EL 0 l = HD l`.
findings.repair:
private axiom hdNil {α : Type u} [Nonempty α] : α

noncomputable def HD {α : Type u} [Nonempty α] : List α → α
  | h :: _ => h
  | [] => hdNil
findings.lean_check:
import CmlTS.Prelude.List

example {α : Type} [Nonempty α] : CmlTS.HD ([] : List α) = CmlTS.ARB := rfl
